title: Retargeting Window & Churn Optimisation

engineFeatures.meaning: the cohort the subject joined, used for the time-based split

label: For "Retargeting Window & Churn Optimisation": Decide whether, when and how long to retarget each visitor to maximise incremental conversions and avoid chasing converted users. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Observational lift inflated by selection.
